glossary.ja: ジョナサングランチャー
glossary.role: Same unit as ジョナサン・グランチャー; this game string just has no middle dot
Queen of the Kingdom of Na; commands the aura battleship Gran-Garan; gives Sho the Billbine
glossary.personality: Serene, dignified young queen with strong Aura Power and a sense of duty to all of Byston Well. Calm but resolute.

glossary.role: Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)
Orphan-loyal Antibody piloted by Reclaimers (generic grunt unit)
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Reclaimer ace of Orphan; pilots Jonathan Grand Cher, later Jonathan Baronz; Yuu's rival and the son of Novis Noah's captain Anoa McCormick
glossary.personality: Arrogant, aggressive and taunting, full of resentment toward Yuu and his own mother. Loyal to Baron Maximilian.

glossary.role: Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.role: Female lead; heir of the Sanc Kingdom (real name Relena Peacecraft), Zechs's younger sister, and a pacifist leader.
glossary.personality: Idealistic, determined pacifist; dignified and unafraid to confront soldiers.

glossary.role: Organization of the Zodiac: elite secret society/military organization inside the Alliance, led by Treize Khushrenada

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of xa_01, covering Extra Mission m6005 (Sanc Kingdom defense with Gran-Garan, Relena Peacecraft, UCE/OZ forces, and generic combat callouts) and the start of m6006 (Gran-Garan underwater retrieval mission featuring Ciela Lapana and the Brain Powerd battle between Yuu Isami and Jonathan Glenn).
uncertainties: Generic battlefield advice lines (m6005#31..m6005#58) represent various player/partner pilot voice personalities responding to barrier mechanics, aggressive offensive tactics, and mission success; kept them diverse and faithful to standard anime tropes. Lines m6006#8..13 speaker inferred as allied tactical coordinator or ship officer.
